∀ {o n : Minidregg.Pred.State} {ps : List Minidregg.Pred.Pred}, Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.all ps) o n = Bool.true ↔ ∀ q ∈ ps, Minidregg.Pred.eval q o n = Bool.true
∀ {o n : Minidregg.Pred.State} {ps : List Minidregg.Pred.Pred}, Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.any ps) o n = Bool.true ↔ ∃ q ∈ ps, Minidregg.Pred.eval q o n = Bool.true
∀ {o n : Minidregg.Pred.State} {s : String} {v : ℤ}, Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.eq s v) o n = Bool.true ↔ n.get s = Option.some v
∀ {o n : Minidregg.Pred.State} {a b : String}, Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.eqSlots a b) o n = Bool.true ↔ ∃ x, n.get a = Option.some x ∧ n.get b = Option.some x
∀ {o n : Minidregg.Pred.State} {s : String} {v : ℤ}, Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.le s v) o n = Bool.true ↔ ∃ x, n.get s = Option.some x ∧ x ≤ v
∀ {o n : Minidregg.Pred.State} {a b : String}, Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.leSlots a b) o n = Bool.true ↔ ∃ x y, n.get a = Option.some x ∧ n.get b = Option.some y ∧ x ≤ y

∀ {o n : Minidregg.Pred.State} {a b : String} {k : ℤ}, Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.leSlotsOff a b k) o n = Bool.true ↔ ∃ x y, n.get a = Option.some x ∧ n.get b = Option.some y ∧ x ≤ y + k
∀ {o n : Minidregg.Pred.State} {s : String} {xs : List ℤ}, Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.memberOf s xs) o n = Bool.true ↔ ∃ x, n.get s = Option.some x ∧ x ∈ xs
∀ {o n : Minidregg.Pred.State} {s : String}, Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.monotone s) o n = Bool.true ↔ ∃ a b, o.get s = Option.some a ∧ n.get s = Option.some b ∧ a ≤ b
∀ {o n : Minidregg.Pred.State} {q : Minidregg.Pred.Pred}, Minidregg.Pred.eval q.not o n = Bool.true ↔ ¬Minidregg.Pred.eval q o n = Bool.true
∀ (N : ℕ) (v : String), Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.fieldName N v = "resource/field/" ++ ToString.toString N ++ "/" ++ v
∀ {a b : ℕ} {v : String}, Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.fieldName a v = Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.fieldName b v ↔ a = b
∀ {l : List (String × ℤ)} {k : String}, (∀ q ∈ l, q.1 ≠ k) → List.find? (fun q => q.1 == k) l = Option.none

∀ (t : Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.Turn) (pre post : Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.Values) (N : ℕ), (Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.view t pre post).get (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.fieldName N "after") = Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.get post N

∀ (t : Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.Turn) (pre post : Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.Values) (N : ℕ), (Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.view t pre post).get (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.fieldName N "before") = Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.get pre N
∀ (t : Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.Turn) (pre post : Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.Values), (Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.view t pre post).get "clock/now" = t.now

∀ (t : Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.Turn) (pre post : Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.Values) (N : ℕ) (o : ℤ), Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.get pre N = Option.some o → (Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.view t pre post).get (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.fieldName N "delta") = Option.map (fun x => x - o) (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.get post N)
∀ (t : Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.Turn) (pre post : Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.Values), (Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.view t pre post).get "request/subject" = Option.some t.subject
∀ (t : Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.Turn) (pre post : Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.Values), (Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.view t pre post).get "request/verb" = Option.some t.verb

∀ (N : ℕ), Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.lastc (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.fieldName N "after") = Option.some 'r'
∀ (s t : String), t.toList ≠ [] → Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.lastc (s ++ t) = Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.lastc t
∀ (N : ℕ), Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.lastc (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.fieldName N "before") = Option.some 'e'
∀ (N : ℕ), Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.lastc (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.fieldName N "delta") = Option.some 'a'
∀ (N : ℕ) (v : String), v.toList ≠ [] → Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.lastc (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.fieldName N v) = Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.lastc v
∀ (a b : ℕ), Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.lastc (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.pairName a b) = Option.some 'a'
∀ {c : Option ℤ} {q : String × ℤ}, q ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.clockSlots c → q.1 = "clock/now"

∀ {pre post : Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.Values} {q : String × ℤ}, q ∈ List.filterMap (fun p => Option.map (fun old => (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.fieldName p.1 "delta", p.2 - old)) (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.get pre p.1)) post → ∃ m, q.1 = Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.fieldName m "delta"
∀ {j : List (ℕ × ℕ × String × ℤ)} {q : String × ℤ}, q ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.jointSlots j → ∃ i n v, q.1 = Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.jointName i n v

∀ {pre post : Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.Values} {q : String × ℤ}, q ∈ List.flatMap (fun a => List.filterMap (fun b => do let oldA ← Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.get pre a.1 let oldB ← Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.get pre b.1 Pure.pure (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.pairName a.1 b.1, a.2 + b.2 - oldA - oldB)) post) post → ∃ a b, q.1 = Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.pairName a b
∀ {v s : ℤ} {q : String × ℤ}, q ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.request v s → q.1 = "request/verb" ∨ q.1 = "request/subject"
∀ {s t : String}, Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.headc s ≠ Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.headc t → s ≠ t
∀ {s t : String}, Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.lastc s ≠ Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.lastc t → s ≠ t
∀ (a b : ℕ), Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.pairName a b = "resource/pair/" ++ ToString.toString a ++ "/" ++ ToString.toString b ++ "/delta"
∀ (a b N : ℕ) (v : String), Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.pairName a b ≠ Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.fieldName N v

∀ {v s : ℤ} {q : String × ℤ}, q ∈ Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.request v s → ∀ (N : ℕ) (w : String), Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.lastc w = Option.some 'r' ∨ Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.lastc w = Option.some 'e' ∨ Minidregg.Kernel.LawView.lastc w = Option.some 'a' → w.toList ≠ [] → q.1 ≠ Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.fieldName N w

∀ (pre post : Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.Values), Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.scalarSlots pre post = List.map (fun p => (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.fieldName p.1 "before", p.2)) pre ++ List.map (fun p => (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.fieldName p.1 "after", p.2)) post ++ List.filterMap (fun p => Option.map (fun old => (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.fieldName p.1 "delta", p.2 - old)) (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.get pre p.1)) post ++ List.flatMap (fun a => List.filterMap (fun b => do let oldA ← Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.get pre a.1 let oldB ← Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.get pre b.1 Pure.pure (Minidregg.Kernel.DeclaredResourceProjection.pairName a.1 b.1, a.2 + b.2 - oldA - oldB)) post) post
∀ (l : List (String × ℤ)) (k : String), { slots := l }.get k = Option.map (fun x => x.2) (List.find? (fun q => q.1 == k) l)
